The Story: Production v9 Release

The v9 bundle is the canonical production release of json-transformer-funcs-one-dimension. It incorporates runtime validation contracts, deep placeholder interpolation, and dual-mode dispatch (uniform fromCollection and individual loopWithIndividualTemplate).

Importing min.js auto-registers the library onto window.ks.transformer.funcs.oneDimension: 

import fromCollection from "./min.js";

// Or access via global:
const result = window.ks.transformer.funcs.oneDimension.fromCollection(sourceArray, templateObject);
